Order Flow.signal_generation: Signals are generated when the current trading volume exceeds the average volume over a specified period by a pre-defined multiplier threshold [1]. These signals only trigger during defined market hours [1]. The script then analyzes price direction—comparing the current close to the previous close—to label the spike as upward (green background) or downward (red background) [1].
Order Flow.confidence_or_scoring: Confidence is established by the 'significance' of the volume spike relative to the average volume, controlled by the user-defined multiplier [1]. The script uses directional bias as a secondary filter to ensure the spike is mapped to price movement [1].
Order Flow.best_timeframe: Intraday (specifically during market hours; demonstrated using specific timestamps like 9:30 AM and 12:25 PM) [1].
setup_steps: Define Market Hours in the script (defaulted to 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.) [1].
Specify the lookback period for calculating the average volume [1].
Set the multiplier threshold to define what constitutes a 'significant' volume spike [1].
Enable visual background changes (green for upward, red for downward) for directional identification [1].
Configure the alert system to trigger notifications for detected spikes with directional bias [1].

key_concepts: Opening gaps (weekend gaps) caused by impactful news while markets are closed [1, 2]
Gap Opening Level (price of the last candle close before the gap) and Gap Closing Level (price of the first candle open after the gap) [2]
Gap Filling: The expectation that price will eventually return to the Gap Opening Level [3, 4]
Liquidity Zones (Supply/Demand): Key areas where the market seeks liquidity before reversing to fill the gap [4-7]
Market Structure Shift: Using consolidation and breakouts to identify the exact moment a gap fill begins [6, 8, 9]
Sentiment/Gap.signal_generation: For a gap down, wait for price to test a significant liquidity demand zone and consolidate under minor resistance [5, 8]. The signal is a bullish breakout and candle close above that resistance [8, 9]. For a gap up, wait for a test of a liquidity supply zone and consolidation above minor support; the signal is a bearish breakout and candle close below that support [6].
Sentiment/Gap.confidence_or_scoring: Based on the high probability that most gaps on gold are filled [3, 4]. Confidence is increased by identifying a 'bullish imbalance candle' as evidence of buyer strength and ensuring at least a 1.1 reward-to-risk ratio [9-11].
setup_steps: Identify a gap-up or gap-down opening after the weekend [1, 12].
Define the 'Gap Opening Level' as your primary take-profit target [2, 10].
Wait for price to reach a significant liquidity zone (demand for gap down, supply for gap up) [4-6].
Monitor for accumulation/consolidation where price respects minor intraday support or resistance [6-8].
Execute the trade upon a confirmed breakout and candle close beyond the consolidation structure [6, 8, 9].
Set stop loss below consolidation lows (for longs) or above consolidation highs (for shorts) [6, 8, 10].
Enter either immediately on the breakout or via a limit order on a retest of the broken structure [6, 8, 10, 11].
